The sample exposed degenerate 1.0-containment matches on trivially short spec titles ('Calculate with money.', 'E = Q this equation', 'r = BQ a magnetic field') — one of which carried a parent row and would have emitted a wrong row. Fix applied (min 3 informative tokens), map regenerated, all three pairs confirmed excluded, sample re-verified. Semantics of the surviving mid-band (0.55-0.6) matches spot-confirmed sound (energy-level vs reaction-pathway diagrams; chromatogram interpretation).
